## Design

### 2026-10-11 – At this point, research is finished. All the components are also chosen. I also made the schematic, since it is not too hard. Then I spent a bit more time to check the schematic, and adding footprints

**8h**

At this point, research is finished. All the components are also chosen. I also made the schematic, since it is not too hard. Then I spent a bit more time to check the schematic, and adding footprints. Then I placed all the components, but no routing took place.
